title: V03 Clip 24
shots: So here are the three signals I'd watch.
semi-3D: data-center aisle, you point; three numbered signal chips pop in
First, spending. When the big tech companies talk about next year, do they raise their plans, or pause?
3D pad: the plans bar rises (RAISE) then stalls (PAUSE) under a glass panel
Second, margins. Nvidia already expects to keep a little less of each dollar next quarter.
3D balance scale: coins kept on the right pan shrink a little
If that keeps slipping, prices or competition are starting to bite.
the kept pile slips again; a red arrow and PRICES / COMPETITION tags
Third, debt. The more of the buying that's borrowed, the closer this gets to Cisco.
debt chain links Nvidia to Cisco, slowly growing; camera drifts from Nvidia to Cisco
